name: browser
description: Browse and act on any website with nothing connected; where it must be you, persistent human-authenticated sessions you log into once by hand (several accounts per site). Paying stops for your approval by default; posting, sending and deleting go ahead and are logged for you; set careful and all four wait for your yes. Never solves a security challenge; it stops and asks you.

verbs.name: browser
verbs.summary: log into a site once, then let adapters operate it

setup.hint: browser needs a root-created profile store that 5dive will not create behind your back, and a Chrome on the box.
